Hilary Roverud, City Manager

Agenda Item: Agreement with Eide Bailly Advisory LLC for Governmental Accounting Technical and
Financial Reporting Consulting Services

Executive Summary: The Finance Department requires specialized, as-needed support for complex
governmental accounting and financial reporting matters, including GASB compliance, lease and
subscription-based IT arrangement accounting, compensated absences, fair-value analyses, technical
accounting research, audit support, and the City’s Financial Transactions Report. Following a
competitive RFP process, staff evaluated eleven proposals using the City’s published criteria. Eide
Bailly Advisory LLC was identified as the best-qualified firm based on its governmental accounting
expertise, understanding of the City’s financial reporting environment and systems, relevant public-
sector experience, proposed work plan, and pricing.

Requested Action / Suggested Motions: Pass a Motion authorizing and directing the Mayor to execute
a Professional Services Agreement with Eide Bailly Advisory LLC for Governmental Accounting
Technical and Financial Reporting Consulting Services for an initial one-year term in an amount not to
exceed $73,200, with up to two optional one-year extensions, and authorizing the City Manager to
execute the aforementioned extensions in writing no later than the expiration of the then-current term.

Responsible Staff Member: Olga Tikhomirova, Director of Finance

Reviewed and Approved By: Susan Blankenship, City Clerk Sergio Rudin, Interim City Attorney

Attachments:
     01-Staff Report Financial Reporting Services.docx
     02-Request for Proposals No. 2026-08-03 and Addendum No. 1.pdf

City of South Lake Tahoe
                               Report to City Council



Meeting Date: October 6, 2026


Title: Agreement with Eide Bailly Advisory LLC for Governmental Accounting Technical and
       Financial Reporting Consulting Services

Location:     Citywide

Responsible Staff Member:          Olga Tikhomirova, Director of Finance

Background:         The Finance Department periodically requires specialized governmental
accounting and financial reporting support to address complex accounting matters, evaluate new
and existing transactions, prepare supporting schedules and analyses, assist with financial-
statement disclosure support, and respond to technical reporting requirements.
The requested services are advisory in nature and are separate from the City’s independent
financial statement audit. The consultant will provide technical expertise, research, analyses,
recommendations, schedules, calculations, journal-entry support, and related documentation.
The City will retain responsibility for management decisions, accounting policies, internal
controls, financial statement preparation, and final accounting and reporting determinations.
The scope of services includes as-needed support for Governmental Accounting Standards
Board (GASB) requirements, including GASB Statement No. 72, Fair Value Measurement and
Application; GASB Statement No. 87, Leases; GASB Statement No. 96, Subscription-Based
Information Technology Arrangements (SBITAs); GASB Statement No. 101, Compensated
Absences; future GASB pronouncements; technical accounting and information technology
consultation; audit support related to consultant-prepared work products; and preparation
support for the City’s Financial Transactions Report submitted to the California State Controller’s
Office.
The City issued Request for Proposals No. 2026-08-03 for Governmental Accounting Technical
and Financial Reporting Consulting Services. The RFP stated that the City anticipated using
these services on an as-needed basis, with no minimum amount of work guaranteed. The
selected consultant may perform only services specifically authorized by the Finance Director or
designee, and compensation may not exceed the approved contract amount without a written
amendment.
The proposed agreement would have an initial term of one year and may be extended for up to
two additional one-year terms, subject to satisfactory performance, annual appropriations,
mutual written agreement, and applicable City purchasing approvals.

Issue and Discussion: The City received eleven proposals in response to the RFP. The
proposals were reviewed for responsiveness to the RFP requirements and evaluated using the
criteria identified in the RFP. The RFP required proposers to demonstrate governmental
accounting, GASB implementation, financial reporting, and information technology consulting

                                                                                                      2

experience; provide qualified proposed personnel; present a practical work plan and timeline;
identify hourly billing rates and estimated fees; and provide recent, relevant public-sector
references.
Three reviewers assessed the eleven firm proposals based on the mandatory and technical
qualifications required by the RFP. The grid below is a recap of the review.

                                 Evaluator #1    Evaluator #2   Evaluator #3
        Vendor/Proposer Name     Total Score     Total Score    Total Score    Total Score      Ranking
Eide Bailly Advisory LLC              93              90             91           274              1
Price Paige & Company, LLP            93              88             89           270              2
Macias Gini & O’Connell LLP           89              89             89           267              3
BerryDunn                             87              84             81           252              4
Cherry Bekaert                        85              82             81           248              5
Forvis Mazars, LLP                    77              83             79           239              6
Vasquez & Company LLP                 82              79             76           237              7
LSL, LLP                              54              87             88           229              8
Badawi & Associates                   78              71             78           227              9
Ernst & Young LLP                     68              75             80           223             10
Weaver and Tidwell, LLP               56              80             81           217             11

Following the evaluation, staff determined that Eide Bailly Advisory LLC was the highest-ranked
proposer and best suited to provide the requested services.
Eide Bailly demonstrated a thorough understanding of the City’s financial reporting environment
and the nature of the requested as-needed technical consulting engagement. Its proposal
specifically addresses the City’s existing CentralSquare OneSolution environment, the planned
transition to Finance Enterprise, Excel-based reporting processes, LeaseQuery-related lease
and subscription-based information technology arrangement tracking, financial reporting
schedules, technical accounting analyses, audit support, and California State Controller
reporting needs.
Eide Bailly proposed an engagement team led by James Ramsey, Managing Director; Kyle
Bartle, Senior Manager and project manager; and Kinnaly Soukhaseum, Managing Director. The
team will be supported by additional governmental accounting specialists as needed. The
proposed team brings experience working with California governmental entities, financial
reporting requirements, governmental accounting standards, audit-ready workpapers, and
public-sector reporting matters.
Eide Bailly’s proposed approach includes:
         An initial kickoff meeting to confirm priorities, anticipated service needs, communication
          protocols, document requirements, and coordination procedures;
         Development of a work plan and secure process for document transfer, tracking, and
          retention;
         Research and technical analysis of applicable GASB and governmental financial
          reporting requirements;
         Preparation of calculations, schedules, journal-entry recommendations, disclosure
          support, technical memoranda, and related workpapers;
         Internal quality review of significant technical analyses and supporting documentation;
         Periodic status updates and ongoing consultation during the contract term; and

Agenda Item: Agreement with Zenith Economics for Economic Development Market Study and
Business Attraction Strategy

Executive Summary: The City of South Lake Tahoe is seeking to advance its economic-development
objectives by contracting with Zenith Economics to prepare an Economic Development Market Analysis
and Business Attraction Strategy. Staff recommends that the City Council pass a motion authorizing and
directing the Mayor to execute a Professional Services Agreement with Zenith Economics in an amount
not to exceed $80,100.00. The project will provide a data-driven assessment of South Lake Tahoe’s
current economic conditions, market opportunities, workforce and infrastructure needs, business
environment, and dependence on tourism. It will identify and prioritize viable “second economy”
sectors that can complement the City’s visitor-serving economy, support year-round employment,
broaden the local tax base, promote business resiliency, and attract private investment. The City issued
a Request for Proposals and received 23 proposals. Following a thorough evaluation by the selection
committee, Zenith Economics was selected as the most qualified firm based on their experience,
understanding of the City’s needs, proposed approach, capacity, and cost. The proposed agreement
amount is within the approved project budget of $100,000.00. The consultant’s work will include
economic and market analysis; stakeholder and community engagement; assessment of business
attraction, retention, and expansion opportunities; identification of target industries; infrastructure,
workforce, and policy considerations; and development of a prioritized implementation plan. Final
deliverables will include draft and final reports, an executive summary, implementation
recommendations, and presentations to the City Council. This project advances the City’s
2025–2030 Strategic Plan, Priority #4, Grow and Diversify the Economy, and will provide the analysis,
strategy, and actionable roadmap needed to help complete the City’s Economic Development
Strategy.

Requested Action / Suggested Motions: Pass a Motion authorizing and directing the Mayor to execute
a Professional Services Agreement with Zenith Economics for the City’s Economic Development Market
Analysis and Business Attraction Strategy in an amount not to exceed $80,100.00.

Agenda Item: Tahoe Regional Planning Agency Housing Amendments and Water Quality and Mobility
Fees Summary

Executive Summary: Since 2020, the TRPA Governing Board has identified the Tahoe Living Strategic
Priority as one of the agency’s key priorities in the annual operations plan. The TRPA Governing
Board appointed the Tahoe Living Working Group to help identify and prioritize specific, quantifiable local
and regional actions that leverage environmental redevelopment and water quality improvements to
achieve the housing goals of the region. Phase 3 of the Tahoe Living Working Group, is “Cultivating
Community, Conserving the Basin” is a multi-year project to make housing more accessible while
maintaining and improving environmental protections. Staff will provide an overview of the policy
recommendations under analysis at TRPA.

Requested Action / Suggested Motions: Pass a Motion providing policy direction on the Tahoe
Regional Planning Agency Cultivating Communities, Conserving the Basin project and Mobility Mitigation
Fees.
